claim: A one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis (other inputs held at nominal values) leaves the inputs' interactions untested.
quote:
Global approaches are requisite to performing a valid sensitivity
analysis when models feature nonlinearities and interactions.
locator: p. 31 printed (PDF p. 3), Sect. 2; OAT defined as keeping 'all other input factors fixed' on the same page
issue: Adversarial read: Saltelli's claim is stronger (OAT is 'perfunctory, unless the model is proven to be linear', p. 32), so the sentence understates rather than overstates; the cite sits on the limitation clause, not on the design, which is ours. Holds.
